verdict.rationale: LathamDrive offers a legal document generator for incorporation documents and an OpenLaw-based Automated Convertible Note generator with customizable terms, indicating interactive rather than purely static assembly. However, evidence doesn't clarify the breadth of document types covered, whether the interface is fully self-serve online completion, or independent corroboration of the experience. Missing for 10: detail on interactive flow/UI for the generator, coverage beyond incorporation/convertible notes, and third-party confirmation of usability.
